name: wan3.0-video-prime
description: Wan3.0-Video-Prime is the high-speed variant of Wan3.0, matching the capabilities of the standard Wan3.0-Video model. It supports versatile four-modal references and generates videos up to 30 seconds, delivering immersive audiovisual experiences with significantly faster end-to-end generation.
zhDescription: Wan3.0-Video-Prime 是万相3.0 的高速版视频生成模型，能力对齐 Wan3.0-Video 标准版，支持四模态全能参考，最长可生成30秒视频，带来沉浸式视听体验的同时端到端速度显著提升。
longDescription: Wan3.0-Video-Prime is the high-speed variant of Wan3.0, matching the capabilities of the standard Wan3.0-Video model. It supports versatile four-modal references and generates videos up to 30 seconds, delivering immersive audiovisual experiences with significantly faster end-to-end generation.
zhLongDescription: Wan3.0-Video-Prime 是万相3.0 的高速版视频生成模型，能力对齐 Wan3.0-Video 标准版，支持四模态全能参考，最长可生成30秒视频，带来沉浸式视听体验的同时端到端速度显著提升。

modelParameters.description: 频率惩罚，减少重复内容的生成
